messages:
Maya Ortiz: Quick sync - DeltaCorp wants Private + Dedicated pricing but airgapped. asking for two clean options to present: low-touch (higher commit) vs low-fee (more services).
Raj Patel: Proposal: Option A = annual GPU commit (dedicated rates) + per-node ops fee ($/node/mo). Option B = annual commit + flat airgap surcharge + optional PS days.
Leo Zhang: Eng constraints: need Console flag to turn off webhooks + offline package delivery. estimate 3 sprints for minimal runbook + feature flags.
Nina Brooks (Finance): Recommend amortize install PS over year1 and set per-node fee to cover ongoing ops (~25% margin).
Samir Gupta (Legal): No-egress clause ok but define "egress" narrowly and allow signed list of telemetry endpoints. I'll draft short annex.
Maya Ortiz: Launch checklist to present: runbook, pricing grid, legal annex. I'll take to customer tomorrow.
Raj Patel: I'll drop a simple CSV pricing grid and two TCO rows by EOD.
Leo Zhang: I'll paste the minimal runbook bullet list here by 5pm.
Samir Gupta (Legal): Uploaded starter annex to ContractHub.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks team :thumbsup:
